sahneler.ses: Can you use that after a comma? Let's fix this common mistake.

sahneler.once: My brother, that lives in Izmir, is a doctor.
sahneler.sonra: My brother, who lives in Izmir, is a doctor.
sahneler.not: Virgüllü, ek bilgi veren cümlecikte that kullanılmaz.

sahneler.once: This is the city that I told you about.
sahneler.sonra: This is the city about which I told you.
sahneler.not: İkisi de doğru. Ama sıfat cümleciğinde edattan sonra that gelmez: about which ya da about whom.

satirlar: Virgüllü sıfat cümleciği: who / which, that yok
Edat sonda kalırsa that de olur
sahneler.ses: In a non-defining clause, use who or which, never that. In a relative clause, after a preposition, use which or whom. If the preposition stays at the end, you can use that.
Does the prefix in always mean not? Not always.

satirlar: b, m, p önünde im-: impossible
sahneler.ses: Before b, m or p, it becomes im, as in impossible. Before l, it becomes il, as in illegal. Before r, it becomes ir, as in irrelevant.
Invaluable means too valuable to measure. And in inflammable, in doesn't mean not: it burns easily.

sahneler.not: Değersiz değil, paha biçilmez. "Değersiz" için worthless kullanılır.

sahneler.ses: Which one was new to you?
